entry.name: AnimationVM_TickActors
entry.behavior: Clears the per-pass scratch state, checks FRAME_PHASE_COUNTER bit 0, and falls through to the actor pass only when the gate is set.

core.name: AnimationVM_RunActorPass
behavior: Scans all 32 actor records at ACTOR_TABLE_BASE with a 0x42-byte stride.
Requires a live type, a valid resource/link condition, and a nonzero animation cursor.
Synchronizes the frame pointer from the animation record and calls the frame setup helper when it changes.
Dispatches EA-FE commands through ACTOR_VM_DISPATCH_TABLE when the actor timer is zero.
Decrements the actor-local animation timer when command execution is deferred.

conclusion: The common animation service is one gated entry plus one actor-table pass. The split is structural and does not add a second player animation cursor or scheduler phase.
